ref.quote: Leeftijd of anciënniteit 2 351,89 EUR bruto per maand 1 881,58 EUR bruto per maand
ref.note: Legal minimum for a civil servant retiring on age or seniority, single rate, from 1 September 2026; not an average. Proposed by the verifier as a replacement for a rejected average; quote checked against the downloaded page. Unit: 12 × the monthly amount (1,881.58 × 12 = 22,578.96 EUR), so the yearly budget change is compared with a year of the benefit, not with one month.
